notes.title: LONE RUIN - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h1]Good day mages![/h1]
Here is the latest updates that have been added to LONE RUIN 👇

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix issue with un-unlocking survival areas when playing already finished ones
[*] Fix issue where spell upgrades weren't offered at the intended rate
[*] Reroll price lowered
[*] Blessing slots are now offered as rewards before you run out of slots
[*] Ruin Run and the first few Errands are tuned easier
[*] Fixes a few issues with Burn and Chill
[*] UI/UX changes and bugfixes around selecting errands and cloaks
[*] Lower HP on the Three Shades Boss (25000 -> 20000)
[*] Fix issue where you would be locked out of spellcasts during spell recharge
[*] Increase Nova starting un-charged radius
[*] Buff Shards Spell
[*] Buff Scythe Spell
[*] Buff Pulse Spell
[*] Fix issue on Errand X where Three Shades would emit projectiles from the center of the map and not the Shade that got hurt.
[*] Fixes potential crash with Orbitals
[*] Nerfed Ghost Flower+Bleed Cloak combo. Invulnerability time from Bleed Cloak's no longer scales with Ghost Flower.
[/list]

Thanks again for all your amazing feedback, 
Hannes 🧙🏻‍♂️

notes.title: LONE RUIN - THE FOOLS ERRAND UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h1]The Fool's Errand update descends![/h1]
[i]Surprise![/i]

As previously promised, following the release of LONE RUIN by Super Rare Originals and Cuddle Monster Games on January 12th, a big update that attempts to address the player feedback has been in the works  - which is [b]available now![/b]

If you missed it the first time around - LONE RUIN is a spell-based roguelike twin-stick shooter with a focus on replayability. Play as an explorer who seeks a mysterious ancient power and venture into a ruined magical city, built atop a source of magic used by olden mages to power and transform themselves. Dive deeper and deeper, battling your way through twisted creatures, utilising your very own magic abilities to ultimately reach the center of the LONE RUIN.

Read on for a rundown on what's included in the Fool's Errand update. 👁️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41818804/52cb8baf9e96c0704fd30c8432c8ff5f35d7f440.gif[/img]
[h3]LONE RUIN has evolved into LONE RUIN - [i]Fool's Errand![/i][/h3]
Descend into the ruins again on a foolish errand to gather magical cloaks from a time long since passed. Truly test your sorceress skills with a brand new progression-based system in the Ruin Run.
[list]
[*] [b]Fool's Errand progression[/b] - an ascension-style progression system replaces the difficulty selection, growing gradually more difficult the more successful runs you complete. Can you reach the very end of this eternal ruin?
[*] [b]Cloaks[/b] - a brand new game mechanic is introduced with the cloaks, which are unlocked at successful Errand intervals. Will you wear the Cloak of Bleeding, the Cloak of Learning, or another magical cloak to gain additional abilities and boosts? Cloaks work in both the main Ruin Run and Survival modes.
[*] [b]Survival mode update[/b] - unlock biomes to play with in the Survival mode, including the Infected Gardens, Ghoul Grave, and Goop Temple. You can now also select from all the spells in Survival, just like in Ruin Run.
[*] [b]Shop updates[/b] - Reroll and Sacrifice options have now been added to the shop, allowing for more thoughtful (or instinctive) decisions during your runs.
[*] [b]Steam achievements[/b] - new achievements introduced to tie in with the new content, encouraging you to play for longer to complete everything the ruins have to offer.
[*] [b]Balance tweaks[/b] - general balance tweaks and fixes have been introduced.
[/list] Additionally, LONE RUIN's soundtrack is now available on Steam! You can pick up [b]LONE RUIN at a discounted price on Steam from March 6th - March 10th[/b], so now's the perfect time to dive in. 

We'll be tweaking the game further based on additional feedback during Fool's Errand launch.

Thank you for your patience, and try to take on [i]the Fools Errand![/i]
- Hannes 🧙‍♂️

notes.title: LONE RUIN - Scoreboard Competition & Update
notes.notes:
[h3][b]📣 Happy launch week! 📣 [/b][/h3]

We're celebrating by running a scoreboard competiton within the game! Starting right now! Here's how you enter:

Firstly, load up LONE RUIN, select Hard difficulty and click SURVIVAL mode. You'll have ten minutes to defeat as many monsters as you can!

Secondly, screenshot your place on the leaderboard. Then, use the hashtag #LONERUINSCORE and tag us Twitter.

Finally, we'll stop the clock at 11:59pm (GMT) on the 20th of January. Once we've collected all the data from the runs, we'll announce the winners on our social channels on the 23rd!

We have a [b]$1000 prize pool[/b] for the top three winners.

🥇 $750
🥈 $200
🥉 $50

And if you place within the top ten, you'll recieve a digital key for either Grapple Dog or LONE RUIN on the platform of your choice.

Survive as long as you can, demolish monsters and get the highest score! Good luck!

- Super Rare Games & Cuddle Monster Team

P.S. There's more T&C's here about submissions/giveaway receiving: [url=https://www.superrareoriginals.com/front-page/lone-ruin-competition-rules]Full Compeition Rules[/url]

P.P.S. Thank you for all your really vaulable feedback over the game's launch. We are planning to make some immediate changes and then release a [b]short-term roadmap[/b] to make some improvements to the game based on current reviews/forum posts.

Please keep sending feedback, and thank you for your passion! Happy Launch Weekend!

notes.title: Lone Ruin Demo Patch Notes 2022-06-17:
notes.notes:
Here's another round of changes as suggested by you peeps!
Keep the feedback flowing, it's so useful!

[list]
[*] You can now move while casting (experimental, leave feedback plz!)
[*] You can now dash even if another spell is already active (experimental, leave feedback plz!)
[*] Skull Bats no longer have inaccurate shots
[*] Chasers (little meatballs) no longer track your direction after jumping backwards
[*] Worms should longer run off ledges
[*] Softer low health warning overlay
[*] Changes to the description of some items
[*] You can no longer click to reorder spells when NOT in Character Details mode (press TAB/View)
[/list]

Thanks everyone!
/Hannes

notes.title: Patch notes Lone Ruin Demo 2022-06-13

Keep the feedback flowing!
And don't forget to Wishlist!

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 2022-06-09
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch notes for Lone Ruin 2022-06-09[/h1]
Based on your feedback, here's a few fixes and adjustments!

[list]
  [*] Leaderboards are now separated by difficulty.
  [*] Easy difficulty now gets upgrades faster and has a few more enemies.
  [*] Slightly Reduced Enemy melee hitbox size and timing.
  [*] Fixed bug where you couldn't dash for a long time after shooting a Fire Ball and some other spells.
  [*] Boomerang Spell is now a starting spell and has been buffed.
  [*] Rail Spell now scales with Radius.
  [*] Barrage Spell buffed.
  [*] Cold Dash trail damage nerfed.
  [*] Changed Enemy Projectile Look to make them more distinct.
  [*] Fixed a Bug that caused an error log every frame. Might make the game more performant.
  [*] Worm enemies should get stuck less often.
  [*] Gold Magnet effect reduced.
  [*] Base pull radius and force increased.
[/list]  

Thanks to everyone who has played so far!
Keep the feedback coming! <3
/Hannes
